This hall is equipped with a large open floor concept, kitchen, washrooms and a mezzanine. The Lakeside Park Pavilion is located at 315 Queen Street in Kingsville. This large open concept facility can seat up to 200 people. The facility offers washrooms, a full kitchen, walk-in-cooler, sound system, stage and large dance floor. services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: Planning a child's birthday party can be overwhelming. Let us take the reins! Our stress-free party package offers a fun-filled experience for kids while giving parents a much-needed break. Our dedicated staff will handle practically every detail, from exciting activities and inventive crafts to colourful decorations and the tasty ice cream sundae bar. We ensure your child's special day is unforgettable. All you need to bring is your lunch and friends! Birthday parties run for two hours: an hour of staff-led activities (active games and crafts), a half-hour to make and eat your ice cream sundae, and a half-hour for opening presents.
